newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans rise after USDA figures.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans rise after USDA figures.

text.p: Argentine soybean prices rose strongly in cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals exchnage as the market reacted to a cut in projected U.S. soybean ending stocks included in a USDA report, traders said.

Prices paid to producers for spot soybeans in Buenos Aires rose $8 to $300. Other grain trade was slow. Wheat prices were mixed in good trade. Bahia Blanca spot was steady at $135. April maize was unchanged at $101 in thin trade. April sunflower seed sagged $2 to $201 in slow trade.
